# New for musivum: the payloads of reference_output.txt, one in hex per line ("empty" is the
# payload without bytes). testdata/reference_output_test.go says how the output is made.
# The order counts for one part of the output: "vp9r" reads every payload into one VP9 packet
# that is trimmed after an error only.

# chooses what the bit reader reads, see refBrDump), and such numbers in a H.264 SPS.
